entries.title: Proverbs 28:1
segments: The wicked flee when no man pursueth; But the righteous are bold as a lion.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:2
segments: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof; But by men of understanding [and] knowledge the state [thereof] shall be prolonged.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:3
segments: A needy man that oppresseth the poor Is [like] a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:4
segments: They that forsake the law praise the wicked; But such as keep the law contend with them.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:5
segments: Evil men understand not justice; But they that seek Jehovah understand all things.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:6
segments: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, Than he that is perverse in [his] ways, though he be rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:7
segments: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son; But he that is a companion of gluttons shameth his father.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:8
segments: He that augmenteth his substance by interest and increase,  Gathereth it for him that hath pity on the poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:9
segments: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, Even his prayer is an abomination.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:10
segments: Whoso causeth the upright to go astray in an evil way, He shall fall himself into his own pit; But the perfect shall inherit good.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:11
segments: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; But the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:12
segments: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; But when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:13
segments: He that covereth his transgressions shall not prosper: But whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall obtain mercy.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:14
segments: Happy is the man that feareth alway; But he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:15
segments: [As] a roaring lion, and a ranging bear, [So is] a wicked ruler over a poor people.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:16
segments: The prince that lacketh understanding is also a great oppressor; [But] he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:17
segments: A man that is laden with the blood of any person Shall flee unto the pit; let no man stay him.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:18
segments: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be delivered; But he that is perverse in [his] ways shall fall at once.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:19
segments: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain [persons] shall have poverty enough.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:20
segments: A faithful man shall abound with blessings; But he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be unpunished.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:21
segments: To have respect of persons is not good; Neither that a man should transgress for a piece of bread.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:22
segments: he that hath an evil eye hasteth after riches, And knoweth not that want shall come upon him.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:23
segments: He that rebuketh a man shall afterward find more favor Than he that flattereth with the tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:24
segments: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression, The same is the companion of a destroyer.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:25
segments: He that is of a greedy spirit stirreth up strife; But he that putteth his trust in Jehovah shall be made fat.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:26
segments: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool; But whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:27
segments: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack; But he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:28
segments: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; But when they perish, the righteous increase.
